achievements.name: Your Own Hero
achievements.detail: Create the protagonist, setting an appearance, a voice, and a favorite dish.

achievements.name: Chosen Job
achievements.detail: Pick one of the eight jobs and fight with that job's weapons and skills.

achievements.name: Break and Boost
achievements.detail: Break a foe by clearing every shield point, then spend Boost Points on the follow-up.

achievements.name: Eight Together
achievements.detail: Win a battle with all eight party members, front row and back row.

achievements.name: Ultimate Technique
achievements.detail: Fill the Ultimate gauge to its highest level and unleash that technique.

achievements.name: Path Action
achievements.detail: Succeed at a Path Action that depends on wealth, power, or fame.

achievements.name: Traveler Recruited
achievements.detail: Recruit a companion and add that traveler to the party.

achievements.name: Wishvale Rebuilt
achievements.detail: Rebuild Wishvale with a hub for cooking, a field or ranch, a shop, and a training ground.

achievements.name: Shared Skill
achievements.detail: Master an Action Skill at the training ground and equip it on another companion.

achievements.name: Amity Raised
achievements.detail: Raise a companion's Amity in Wishvale until the closer bond pays off.

achievements.name: Set Sail
achievements.detail: Board a ship and land on an island in the Middlesea or the Outersea.

achievements.name: Path's End
achievements.detail: Follow the road of revenge or of restoration through the story's last chapter.
